entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I'm just so confused. I ordered this jersey, and it's not right. The website was a bit overwhelming, and I think I messed it up.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's... it's the wrong size. I thought I ordered the right one, but when it arrived, it's just way too tight. I can barely get it on. I wanted to do an exchange, but the online portal is... a lot. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely handle this for you directly. I just need to pull up your order. Do you have the order number handy?
I think so... hold on. It's VF88675309.
Thank you. Let me see... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line Aero jersey, delivered 32 days ago. And thank you for being one of our VIP members, we really appreciate your loyalty.
Oh, I didn't even know I was one of those. I just know this jersey is too tight and I feel a bit lost on how to fix it.

Not a problem at all. Looking at our policy for standard items like this jersey, you're well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely process an exchange for you to get you the correct size. No need to use the website.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending you a pre-paid return label to your email now. To make up for the confusion with the website, I've also upgraded the shipping on your new, larger-sized jersey to complimentary overnight express, so you'll have it tomorrow. How does that sound?
Wow, that's amazing! Thank you so much, David. You've been a huge help.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Have a wonderful day and enjoy your new jersey when it arrives.
